corrections.reason: The skill asks kids to use decision steps to pick a safe choice, but no listed prerequisite teaches those steps. g4-hlth-safe-decisions is the direct source of that skill. It is not already a dependency of either listed prerequisite, so it is not redundant.

The skill asks kids to see how explicit media gives a wrong idea about relationships. Kids need the Grade 3 picture of what a healthy relationship looks like to spot that distortion. This prerequisite is not already covered by the other two, which do not depend on it.

output.notes: Reviewed all 14 proposed Grade 6 skills against the prerequisite rules. Most prerequisite lists are direct, needed, and point backward in the graph. Two skills needed a change: g6-hlth-drug-choices is missing the decision-steps skill it asks kids to use, and g6-hlth-explicit-media is missing the healthy-relationships baseline it depends on for the "wrong idea about relationships" outcome. Titles and descriptions read clearly aloud and need no edits. Some judgment calls were left as-is, such as whether g6-hlth-support-services needs g5-hlth-trusted-help directly; it is covered through g5-hlth-helping-others, which is the mental-health-specific prerequisite.
